answer: Before a newcomer's submission counts, it presents a relic seal to the ledge registry: a proof-of-work answer bound to its device key and a fresh nonce, at registry difficulty. A panel checks it in ten minutes and posts the plume. A copied seal fails since its answer never matches the fresh nonce; a second identity at the old difficulty voids the entry and bars it a cycle. One honest newcomer spends two minutes once; a thousand fakes need a thousand puzzles, the thousandth costing two thousand minutes, since the difficulty rises one step per identity.
